meta.excluded: The court-line tile (docs/design/assets/court.svg) is left out on purpose so the system works for any brand surface.

tokens.name: vg-ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and dark fills (selected segment, step badge, active option). Text on paper, glass and every chip ground (14.6:1 on paper). Dark: warm off-white text, 15.9:1 on paper and 13.7:1 on glass.

tokens.name: vg-paper
tokens.usage: Page base under the texture. Set it as the body background colour so the page is never blank while the texture loads.

tokens.name: vg-paper-top
tokens.usage: Top-left stop of the page gradient in the `vg-tex` surface.

tokens.name: vg-paper-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom-right stop of the page gradient in the `vg-tex` surface.

tokens.name: vg-white
tokens.usage: Pure white in both themes: text on smoked glass, the tab bar and type badges; the switch knob; the icon on the raised round action. For text on `vg-ink` or `vg-accent` fills use `vg-on-ink` and `vg-on-accent`.

tokens.name: vg-on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `vg-ink` fill: selected segments, tabs and options, step badges (including done). Light: 17.2:1. Dark: 15.2:1 on ink, 10.4:1 on the done green.

tokens.name: vg-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a `vg-accent` fill: the primary button. Light: white, 7.3:1. Dark: near black, 7.2:1.

tokens.name: vg-surface-solid
tokens.usage: Opaque control fill: the pairing code boxes.

tokens.name: vg-switch-on
tokens.usage: Switch track when on (fresh green); the `vg-white` knob reads 4.4:1 (light) and 4.2:1 (dark) on it.

tokens.name: vg-ring-gap
tokens.usage: Page-coloured gap between the raised round action and its `vg-accent-soft` ring.

tokens.name: vg-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: table header rule, dividers between groups.

tokens.name: vg-line-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet rules inside a card: table body rows, settings rows, the meter track.

tokens.name: vg-line-strong
tokens.usage: Input, duration box and code entry borders; the switch track when off. Decorative weight only (1.3:1 on paper): the field's fill and label carry the control, so never rely on this border alone. Dark: 2.4:1 on paper.

tokens.name: vg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, notes, unselected segments and tabs. 7.8:1 on paper. Dark: 9.9:1 on paper, 8.5:1 on glass.

tokens.name: vg-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: Oswald labels, table headers, placeholders, the grip icon. 4.7:1 on paper; keep it off pale glass tints darker than paper. Dark: 7.3:1 on paper, 4.8:1 under the brightest glass sheen.

tokens.name: vg-accent
tokens.usage: Royal blue, the one accent (trust, competence, royalty). Primary button fill, selected borders, links, the focus ring, the drop target ring. Light: 6.2:1 on paper, 6.7:1 on glass, `vg-on-accent` text on it 7.3:1. Dark: a lighter blue, 7.5:1 on paper and 6.4:1 on glass, with dark `vg-on-accent` text (7.2:1).

tokens.name: vg-accent-dark
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and link hover. Light: deeper blue, 8.2:1 on paper. Dark: goes lighter, not darker (10.3:1 on paper).

tokens.name: vg-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Accent on smoked glass only: the sliding marker under the current top bar link, the active phone tab marker and the ring round the raised round action (5.5:1 on light smoke, 8.1:1 on dark). Not for text on light grounds.

tokens.name: vg-accent-deep
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the raised round action's gradient (`vg-accent-soft` to `vg-accent` to `vg-accent-deep`).

tokens.name: vg-fresh
tokens.usage: Fresh green, the second brand colour (fresh, quality). Success marks, positive meter segments, the switch when on, the green glow. Fills and marks only on light grounds (3.7:1 on paper); white text on it 4.4:1. Dark: 7.8:1 on paper.

tokens.name: vg-confidence
tokens.usage: Confidence orange, a small highlight: featured badges, chart highlights, the centre glow. Never text on light grounds (2.2:1); put `vg-ink` on it (6.7:1). Dark: 9:1 on paper.

tokens.name: vg-danger
tokens.usage: Errors only: invalid field borders and destructive emphasis. Red now means something is wrong and nothing else. Light: 5.0:1 on paper. Dark: 5.7:1. Error text uses `vg-bad-fg`.

tokens.name: vg-danger-line
tokens.usage: Border of the danger-outline button at rest.

tokens.name: vg-court-1
tokens.usage: Green accent for imagery and success graphics (bars, rings). Not for body text.

tokens.name: vg-court-2
tokens.usage: Deeper green for imagery. White text on it reads 5.2:1.

tokens.name: vg-court-3
tokens.usage: Bright green for imagery.

tokens.name: vg-court-4
tokens.usage: Lime highlight in imagery. Never text.

tokens.name: vg-clay
tokens.usage: Warm orange accent for imagery and charts.

tokens.name: vg-ok-bg
tokens.usage: Success chip ground.

tokens.name: vg-ok-fg
tokens.usage: Success chip text on ok-bg (5.5:1); the switch track when on; the done step badge. Dark: 8.1:1 on ok-bg.

tokens.name: vg-warn-bg
tokens.usage: Warning chip ground.

tokens.name: vg-warn-fg
tokens.usage: Warning chip text on warn-bg (5.8:1) and warning notes on paper. Dark: 8.0:1 on warn-bg.

tokens.name: vg-bad-bg
tokens.usage: Error chip ground; the danger button hover fill.

tokens.name: vg-bad-fg
tokens.usage: Error chip text on bad-bg (6.1:1), error messages and danger button text. Dark: 7.8:1 on bad-bg.

tokens.name: vg-neutral-bg
tokens.usage: Neutral chip ground.

tokens.name: vg-neutral-fg
tokens.usage: Neutral chip text on neutral-bg (7.7:1). Dark: 8.6:1 on neutral-bg.

tokens.name: vg-info-bg
tokens.usage: Info chip ground.

tokens.name: vg-info-fg
tokens.usage: Info chip text on info-bg (6.8:1). Dark: 8.2:1 on info-bg.

tokens.name: vg-glass
tokens.usage: Fill of glass cards, KPI tiles and segmented controls, over the `vg-tex` page.

tokens.name: vg-glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px rim of a glass card.

tokens.name: vg-glass-sheen
tokens.usage: Top of the sheen gradient on a glass card (fades to clear at 38%).

tokens.name: vg-frost
tokens.usage: Default button fill (frosted white over blur 12px).

tokens.name: vg-frost-edge
tokens.usage: Rim of buttons, list rows, option pills and layout cards.

tokens.name: vg-frost-row
tokens.usage: Fill of list rows, option pills and media tiles.

tokens.name: vg-field
tokens.usage: Input and select fill; icon button hover fill.

tokens.name: vg-field-strong
tokens.usage: Duration box fill, a touch more opaque than an input.

tokens.name: vg-select-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of a selected layout card or kind card, with a `vg-accent` border. Text on it is `vg-ink` (14:1 light, 12:1 dark).

tokens.name: vg-smoke
tokens.usage: Smoked-glass top bar, its dropdown menus and dark panels (with blur 24px). Text on it is `vg-white`. Dark: darker than the page so the top bar still stands apart.

tokens.name: vg-smoke-bar
tokens.usage: The phone bottom tab bar.

tokens.name: vg-smoke-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and open fill for links on smoked glass: top bar links, menu links.

tokens.name: vg-smoke-edge
tokens.usage: 1px rim of a smoked-glass dropdown menu.

tokens.name: vg-white-muted
tokens.usage: Resting text of top bar links on `vg-smoke` (8.7:1 light and 11.8:1 dark, at least 7:1 over the red glow corner); hover and the current link go to `vg-white`.

tokens.name: vg-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet body on phones (with blur 24px).

tokens.usage: Backdrop behind a centred modal.

tokens.name: vg-glow-green

tokens.name: vg-glow-amber
tokens.usage: Confidence orange glow in the centre of the page texture.

tokens.name: vg-glow-accent-smoke
tokens.usage: Royal blue glow at the top left of smoked glass (top bar, tab bar, dark panels).

tokens.name: vg-glow-green-smoke
